newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amerada Hess signs Thai oil exloration deal.
newsitem.headline: Amerada Hess signs Thai oil exloration deal.

text.p: Thailand said on Monday it signed an agreement awarding petroleum exploration and production rights to a group led by Amerada Hess Exploration (Thailand), a unit of U.S.-based Amerada Hess Corp.

The group comprised Amerada Exploration, Kerr-McGee (Thailand), a unit of Kerr McGee Corp and Novus Petroleum Exploration (Thailand), a unit of Australia-based Novus Petroleum Ltd, an industry official said.
The group will spend over 250 million baht ($100 million) in the first three years of exploration on inland areas in northeastern Thailand, the official said.
The awarded concession area, coded 5340/38 and 5440/38, covered 5,928 square kms in the northeastern provinces of Chaiyaphum, Khon Kaen and Nakhon Ratchasima, she said.
The Amerada Exploration group was one of five oil firms to win the concessions for petroleum exploration and production in the 15th round of bidding called in February.

The other four were SOCO Exploration (Thailand), a unit of Snyder Oil, Cairn Energy (Thailand), a unit of U.K.-based Cairn Energy, Texaco Exploration (Thailand) II, a unit of Texaco Inc and Anschutz Overseas Corp.
